I have been farming here in Oromia for many years, and I know that beans and legumes do not need much nitrogen because they draw it from the air. I will save the chemical fertilizer for my other plots and instead spread manure from my cattle and goats on this small piece. I will plant seeds I kept from last season's harvest, and my family and I can manage all the work on this 0.08 hectare plot without paying for outside help.
